parsed.note_claim: The regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a drone.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Russian drones attacked a crossing point on the Polish-Ukrainian border on Sunday morning, hitting a passenger train two kilometers from the frontier in Volyn Oblast.
parsed.reason: The article confirms that a passenger train bound for Warsaw was hit by a drone, directly substantiating the first factual claim made in the note.
